batch.topic: A tenant coordinates replacing a cracked window latch: the landlord supplies the part, the tenant returns the old part, and approval is not a completed repair.
A library patron renews two books but one reservation prevents renewal; distinguish the renewal request from confirmation.
A household sorts a bag of donated clothes: clean items go into one box, items needing repair are kept separately, and nothing has been collected yet.
A colleague lends a charger but keeps the cable belonging to a different device; preserve what is borrowed and what stays.
